info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Notional Pooling Insights API
info.description: The Notional Pooling Insights API facilitates the retrieval of detailed information about notional pooling arrangements within trade banking. Users can access essential data points, such as account balances, transaction histories, and interest calculations related to their pooling agreements. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions and corporate treasurers seeking to optimize liquidity management. Typical consumers include financial analysts, risk managers, and finance teams who require real-time insights to support their strategic decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific Notional Pooling resource identified by its unique ID. Ensure that the ID you're querying corresponds to an existing Notional Pooling resource to receive valid data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve notional pooling information for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. It requires the necessary details enclosed in the JSON format to ensure a successful response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the notional pooling resource.

GetNotionalPoolingByIdRequest.description: A request body for the Notional Pooling operations in trading banking context. This string is expected to contain specific information as defined by the operation.
